profile.title: M.Sc. Computer Science Student
profile.headline: I come with a background in Conga & Salesforce Consulting (and Development) along with Operational experience in sales lifecycle. Naturally, I am well-versed in the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle using Conga Product Suite [CPQ, CLM] and learning modern Revenue Management and Operations in the AI era. I am also learning platform agnostic development with security in mind.

projects.name: Salesforce native application for querying Salesforce Attachments and Files
projects.description: A Lightning Web Component (LWC) built on the Salesforce platform that allows users to query and manage Attachments and Files directly from their Salesforce org, streamlining document handling and optimizing org storage. No longer relevant as Attachments are deprecated, so it serves as an example of a Salesforce native application built using LWC and Apex.

projects.name: Data Analytics: Binary Classification prediction model
projects.description: A binary classification model using Python and scikit-learn to predict likely insurance claims based on historical data, comparing multiple algorithms to determine the most effective approach using (FNR) False Negative Rate as the determination metric, demonstrating practical machine learning application and data analysis skills.

projects.name: Full Stack Task Manager
projects.description: A Basic Task Manager application built with FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, featuring RESTful APIs for task management, and a simple frontend interface for task organization and tracking and a database to store the tasks. It is furhter modified to include user authentication and authorization, allowing users to securely manage their tasks and ensuring that only authorized users can access and modify their own tasks using microservices architecture.

experiences.summary: I was tasked to support platform migration of a CPQ solution from Salesforce Conga to Conga Advantage Platform for an Energy Equipment Manufacturer. Received training on Conga Advantage Platform and its features and contributed to optimizing an integration module between an external Configurator that configures products and cart line items which is then fed to the Salesforce Cart for pricing and downstream actions.

experiences.company: Tesla Eco Tech, P.V.E, Redline Games (Small Enterprises)
experiences.summary: I was involved in consulting, implementing and adoption of digital solutions in Business Operations (mostly in the sales lifecycle) plus IT Support & Administration. This includes setting up CRM (HubSpot free edition) for Lead/Opportunity Tracking and automations (Zapier free edition) for alerts in the sales lifecycle. There were many side projects, including but not limited to, GTM strategies: Life Cycle Assessment of raw materials for recycling to expand into new markets, CLV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis: adoption of analytics tools (Google/Firebase Analytics) for mobile games to estimate engagement and retention and plan marketing strategies. I also kept in touch with the Salesforce ecosystem by learning SFDX and JavaScript for LWCs.

experiences.company: Conga (B2B SaaS, formerly known as Apttus)
experiences.summary: I was tasked to provide technical consultation and support the Conga Product (CPQ, CLM, and Billing) implementation typically for 'high-value' clients (ACV > $10M). Conga (then Apttus) product offerings were hosted on several platforms (Salesforce, Apttus Intelligence Cloud on Azure, MS Dynamics). I was trained as an Apttus CPQ, CLM and Billing Admin to help with the responsibilites of the role along with Salesforce Platform Administration since the majority of the client base was using the Salesforce offering which is a managed package in AppExchange and the other two platforms were slated for End-of-Life shortly. This also included providing technical guidance on best practices for using the Conga Product Suite and ensuring that clients are able to fully leverage the capabilities of the product.
